cases.name: Kimberly Rae Schmidt
cases.about:
She was a diving instructor at the Scuba Center of Spokane, WA.

Her obituary said, "Our beautiful daughter -" loving and dedicated mother, cherished niece and cousin, and loyal friend has left us all with a very large empty place in our hearts.
Kim was born in Spokane, graduated from Shadle Park High School, and earned a Master's Degree from Eastern Washington University in Accounting and Business/Human Resource Management. Kim loved the ocean and exploring its creatures and beauty, she was an intense worker for Pitney Bowes, and a true friend. Kim's pride and joy was her daughter and her hard work in dance and school. Her favorite title was "Dance Mom" and enjoyed watching, with a little sadness how her --lil' monkey was growing into a young lady."
cases.narrative: He drugged her with Advil P.M. then shot her once in the head through a sock with her own gun, and autopsy results showed she may have survived for several hours before succumbing to her injuries. Her mother discovered her dead on her bed, with her head covered by a blood-soaked pillow.
